meaning:
Rachal = "trade"
a town in southern Judah to which David sent presents
Another name of kar.mel (כַּרְמֶל "Carmel" H3760G)

renderings.kjv: And to them which were in Rachal

elsewhere.note: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,
